name: Custodian
source: CRON 2026-11-21: Custodian Investment Plc unaudited consolidated financial reports for the nine months ended 30 September 2026 (NGX doclib filing library, financial highlights and consolidated statement of profit or loss, Group 30-Sep-26 column), printed in thousands of naira and scaled to naira. Revenue is the printed Gross Revenue of 255,414,006 thousand, which equals the sum of the printed insurance service revenue, sales, dividend income, interest income, fees and commission and other operating income lines. Cost of Sales is the printed cost of sales line of 7,446,305 thousand and Gross Profit is Revenue less that line. Operating Expenses, EBIT and Net Finance Costs are left blank because the printed operating expense subtotal of 195,813,867 thousand overlaps the insurance service, reinsurance and cost of sales lines and cannot be split from the highlights without double counting. Profit before taxation less income tax of 8,606,102 thousand equals the printed profit for the period of 57,594,690 thousand. | NGX audited annual report (filed PDF, _ngx_pdf) FY2025 | CRON 2026-10-07 NGX Q2 2026 filing fill: Group column headed 30-Jun-26, NGN thousands. Gross Revenue 167,620,937; Profit before taxation 43,137,430; Income tax expense 6,470,120; Profit for the period 36,667,310. Ties: 43,137,430 less 6,470,120 equals 36,667,310. CORRECTION 2026-10-07: the stored H1 2026 Profit Before Tax cell held the period profit 36,667,310, which is the Profit for the period line, not the pre-tax line; it is replaced with the printed 43,137,430 and the income tax expense is filled from the same statement. The filing prints no line named cost of sales or gross profit at group level, so those rows are left blank rather than constructed. Source: https://doclib.ngxgroup.com/Financial_NewsDocs/47628_CUSTODIAN_INVESTMENT_PLC-_QUARTER_2_-_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_FOR_2026_FINANCIAL_STATEMENTS_JULY_2026.pdf | FILL 20261007: H1 2026 balance sheet added from the issuer interim. CUSTODIAN INVESTMENT PLC financial reports for the half year ended 30 June 2026, asset and liability highlights: total assets 1,234,518,169; total liabilities 983,826,512; total equity 250,691,657; cash and cash equivalents 130,698,374 thousand naira. Source: https://doclib.ngxgroup.com/Financial_NewsDocs/47628_CUSTODIAN_INVESTMENT_PLC-_QUARTER_2_-_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_FOR_2026_FINANCIAL_STATEMENTS_JULY_2026.pdf CRON 20261107: H1 2026 rows completed from the issuer interim statement read in the NGX filing library copy on disk. CUSTODIAN: Operating Expenses 118,843,020 thousands printed on page 2 of the interim report for the period ended 30 June 2026, group column, and its sign convention matches the rest of the file (positive). Cost of sales and gross profit are left empty because the statement is a mixed insurance and investment layout and no gross profit line is printed. | CRON 2026-11-28: EPS for the newest period (9M 2026) filled from the filing named below. CUSTODIAN INVT PLC Q3 2026 unaudited group statement of profit or loss, EPS basic and diluted 827 kobo for the nine months to 30 September 2026 (759 kobo for the nine months to 30 September 2025), read from the issuer published PDF at custodianplc.com.ng/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/CUSTODIAN_INVESTMENT_PLC-_QUARTER_3_-_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_FOR_2026.pdf and corroborated by the Nairametrics report of 30 October 2026 which quotes EPS 827 kobo. Stored in naira per share, matching the existing FY2025 cell of 11.494253 (1149 kobo). Profit for the period 57,594,690,000 already stored ties to the same statement.
